name: @krizaka/ui
description: The Krizaka front-end platform's components: the primitives (button, card, dialog, toast, menu, field, tabs, chip, switch, slider, command palette, theme, countdown…) on the semantic --kz-* tokens, the animated marks (Krizaka, Orazaka, Orochia, Yasakia, Yororis) and the motion signature — web and /native.
author: Krizaka (https://www.krizaka.com)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('registry/examples',{recursive:true}))if(/\.(js|d\.ts)$/.test(f))fs.rmSync('registry/examples/'+f)" && tsup && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/motion.css','dist/motion.css');require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/blocks.css','dist/blocks.css');require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/story.css','dist/story.css')" && node scripts/build-registry.mjs
scripts.publint: publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only --exclude-entrypoints ./motion.css ./blocks.css ./story.css ./tailwind.css && node scripts/consumer.mjs && node scripts/native-dist.mjs

size-limit.name: ./native (bundled into the app by Metro, never downloaded: a regression guard, not a budget)
./cn (the shared runtime: clsx + tailwind-variants and its merge engine)
./iso (a hero costs no client JavaScript: server components, static SVG)
./data-table: DataTable (TanStack Table v9, the windowing of TanStack Virtual, Radix Checkbox, the pagination)
./data-table: the toolbar (FilterBar on Radix DropdownMenu, SearchField, the columns menu, the export)
./form (TanStack Form v1; the fields import the primitives' own entries)
./native/form (TanStack Form v1; the platform is the app's)
./genui: GenUiStream (A2UI v0.9 validator, store, surface, base catalog with DataTable)
